status: Representation proposal only; no engine/card implementation or fitted coefficient
baseUnitPolicy: Keep physical quantities in their recorded units, with explicit conversion metadata when needed. No percentile scalar replaces the originals.

height.meaning: Recorded standing stature, shoe protocol retained if known

wingspan.meaning: Arm span; does not receive an additional bonus on top of an observed standing reach

standingReach.meaning: Observed reach; never derived silently from height

strengthTest.meaning: Store test type, load and repetitions separately; no conversion from bench repetitions to a basketball strength rating

standingJump.meaning: No-step jump from dated measurement; not assumed current

runningJump.meaning: Maximum approach jump from dated measurement; not substituted for every rebound jump

missingPolicy: Preserve null and reason. An eventual prior must be a separately registered model with its own estimated flag, training cutoff and uncertainty. No current imputation.
derivedReach: Observed compatible standingReach + observed jump height can describe tested maximum touch height. It is not an automatic effective in-game reach, and cannot be computed when either input or test compatibility is unknown.
futureIntegrationRule: A body-only mechanism must replace its designated old physique pathway under its own switch, rather than stacking new height/mass/jump bonuses on old physique. Other physique pathways stay frozen. No effect coefficient is selected in this audit.
forbidden: Inferring strength/jump from OREB/DREB/BLK and then predicting those same outcomes
Using player/team IDs as prediction exceptions
Interpreting retrospective source fetches as proof of cutoff-time availability
